tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Annual Turnover Certificate last three years
Outsourcing (Labours Outsource) Experience certificate shall be produced by the Contractor issued by not below the Rank of Deputy Conservator of Forest in Karnataka. Otherwise Tender will be Rejected
The Bidder should have submit in the name of Deputy Conservator of Forest, Bangalore Development authority minimum 10 lakh Bank Solvency Certificate Latest Validity Documents Upload

The bidder must be a regular agency involved in Providing Manpower Supply (Senior project consultant, Associate project consultant, Assistant supervisor for plantation) who have at least 3 similar projects with order value of minimum Rs. 10.00 lakh from each order in the last 2 years from any Autonomous bodies/ Universities / Reputed Organizations-firms/ Central and State Government Offices

Rates mentioned in below column might change as per the 2026-27 Financial year allocation from Head of the Department(Ex: wages, EPF, GST, Service charge), Tenderer must issue the services as the allocation received from Head of the Department
